name: site
comment:typescript: svelte-check 4.x refuses to run when the `typescript` package is major 7 (bin/ts-version-check.js). TypeScript 7 is the native compiler, and svelte-check reaches it through the `@typescript/native` alias plus `--tsgo`, keeping `typescript` itself on 6 for the classic API. Collapse these two back into a single `typescript` dependency once svelte-check accepts a bare TS 7.
comment:overrides: Transitive deps held below a patched release by a parent that has not re-published. Drop an entry once the parent's own range reaches it. dompurify<-@rokkit/ui is the only one that reaches the browser; ws/esbuild/sharp<-vite and wrangler>miniflare are build-time only. undici and cookie are the two exceptions and each carries its own note below — do not fold them back into this list, because neither is build-time only and neither stays inside its parent's accepted range.
comment:overrides-cookie: cookie reaches PRODUCTION, not just the build: .svelte-kit/output/server/index.js keeps `from "cookie"` as an external import, so wrangler bundles it into the deployed worker. It is pinned because @sveltejs/kit 2.70.3 — the current release — still declares ^0.6.0, and every 0.6.x is vulnerable to GHSA-pxg6-pf52-xh8x (cookie accepts name/path/domain with out-of-bounds characters, fixed in 0.7.0). Dropping this override reintroduces that advisory. 0.7.0 changed no API (it narrowed validation to RFC6265 and added perf), so kit is safe on it despite the range. It must NOT be raised further: 1.0 returns a null-prototype object from parse, lowercases priority/sameSite and delegates quote-parsing to `decode` — and kit calls parse(header, { decode: (value) => value }) — while 2.0 renames parse/serialize to parseCookie/stringifySetCookie, which breaks kit's import outright. That also means youch's ^1.0.2 cannot be satisfied at the same time; bun has no nested overrides, and youch is reached only through miniflare, which this project never invokes, so youch loses.
comment:overrides-undici: undici is the one entry that crosses a major, because two parents disagree and bun has no nested overrides (it warns and ignores them). jsdom@30 declares ^8.9.0; miniflare pins 7.29.0 exactly, which is vulnerable to the 2026-09-04 advisory batch (patched at 7.29.1 and 8.10.2). 8.10.2 is the only fully-patched release that also satisfies jsdom, so it serves both. Crossing miniflare's major is contained: miniflare only emulates Workers for local dev — the deployed worker runs on Cloudflare's workerd, and wrangler's deploy path does not depend on undici.
